  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  CITY COUNCIL

  REGULAR MEETING

  TUESDAY, DECEMBER 8, 2020 AT 6:00 PM

CALL TO ORDER
The Regular meeting of the City Council of the City of Hawaiian Gardens was called to
order by Mayor Jesse Alvarado on Tuesday, December 08, 2020, at 6:05 PM in the
City Council Chambers, 21815 Pioneer Boulevard, Hawaiian Gardens, California.

Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant I, provided brief information relating to the conduct of
the virtual video meeting due to the COVID-19 pandemic situation, as listed on the
agenda.

INVOCATION
Mayor Alvarado requested everyone to take a moment of silence and remember all
dealing with COVID-19.

FLAG SALUTE
The flag salute was led by Mayor Alvarado.

PROCLAMATIONS AND CERTIFICATES

Shavon Cage, Executive Assistant presented:

  •  3 certificates of appreciation to councilmember Trimble.
  •  3 certificates of appreciation to Mayor Alvarado.

PRESENTATIONS

There was a 4-minute presentation of Mayor Alvarado.

members of the City Council Maria Teresa Del Rio, Victor Farfan, and Myra Maravilla.

Interim City Clerk Poonam Davis opened the nominations for Mayor and Chairmember.

 B.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(S) (ITEM 6)

6.  RESOLUTION NO. 083-2020
  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF HAWAIIAN
  GARDENS, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA,
  UPHOLDING THE PLANNING COMMISSION’S DECISION OF CASE NO.
  PLNG2020-0051-DRB  (DESIGN  REVIEW  BOARD).  FOR THE
  ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN, BUILDING COLORS AND MATERIALS OF A
  PROPOSED FIVE-UNIT APARTMENT COMPLEX ON PROPERTY LOCATED
  AT 12329 214TH STREET, HAWAIIAN GARDENS, CALIFORNIA 90716

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Conduct Public Hearing. Adopt Resolution
  No. 083- 2020.

Mayor Pro Tem Farfan excused himself on this item as his personal property is within
500 feet of the subject property.

Applicant Patel and his architect spoke and provided information as the council asked
questions.

Councilmember Alvarado spoke.

Councilmember Maravilla spoke.

City Manager Ernie Hernandez spoke.

City Attorney Megan Garibaldi spoke.

Joe Colombo, Community Development Director, spoke.

Resolution No. 083-2020 was approved with 3 amendments.
1. For privacy concerns plant cypress trees 24” – 36” box space together, as they grow
taller, they will create privacy.
2. Architect redesign changes (wrought iron) railing and beams Spanish modern style.
3. Reduce height of the building from 35 feet – 30 feet.

It was moved by Councilmember Alvarado, seconded by Councilmember Maravilla, and
approved by roll call vote as follows to adopt Resolution No. 083-2020 as amended.

AYES: MARAVILLA, ROA, ALVARADO, DEL RIO
NOES: NONE
EXCUSED: FARFAN
ABSENT: NONE

Motion carried, 4-0.

  TO PREPARE THE PROJECT PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS FOR
  CALTRANS APPROVAL TO UTILIZE THE $200,000 OF STPL FUNDS FOR
  NORWALK BOULEVARD IMPROVEMENTS

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Council authorize the appropriation of $36,000 of
  Measure R funds to prepare the project plans and specifications for Caltrans
  approval to utilize the $200,000 of STPL funds for Norwalk Boulevard
  improvements.

Councilmember Maravilla spoke.

Councilmember Farfan spoke.

Joe Colombo, Community Development Director, spoke.
